items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Haushaltshilfe
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated/posted Thursday 2026-11-19 by a statutory health insurer (Krankenkasse), a social-law body under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X. Posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 → delivery deemed on the 4th day after posting: 19.11 + 4 days = 23.11.2026 (Monday). Krankenkassen are not tax offices, so even if this fell on a weekend/holiday the delivery day itself would not move — but Monday 23.11.2026 is a working day anyway, so delivery = 23.11.2026. One-month Widerspruch period runs under §§ 187, 188 BGB / § 26 SGB X: the day of delivery (23.11.) is not counted; the period ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW (nor nationwide), so no shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed. Deadline: 23.12.2026.
